LanguageData.mytNS_SpawnProjectionDesc: Release a projection drone and form a nanoswarm projection from inactive nanites housed in the cabinet.
LanguageData.mytNS_RespawnProjectionDesc: Delink from the current projection drone and form a new nanoswarm projection from inactive nanites housed in the cabinet. The previous projection will be destroyed and all items it is carrying dropped.
LanguageData.mytNS_Debug_CreateAIMindDesc: Creates (or recreates) an AI mind for this projection cabinet.
